collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: Watching the moon rise, a child asks whether distant peoples might someday send travelers beyond the sky.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Watching the moon rise, a child asks whether distant peoples might someday send travelers beyond the clouds and even beyond the sky.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The children draw a craft crossing darkness toward the moon, then debate what its travelers would eat.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A navigator asks how travelers would find their way home without familiar stars overhead.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Researchers propose instruments that observe distant worlds without sending people.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The astronomer notes that every observation can be misinterpreted; the group lists questions rather than answers.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A curious villager says discovery itself can be worthwhile.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A farmer asks whether great journeys should take priority over hunger at home; neither view wins automatically.
